title: Hotel Featured in Southern Living! 24x SuperHost
description:
Boutique hotel housed in a beautiful historic church in East Nashville located less than 1.5 miles away from downtown.

*We give away a generous percentage of each night's stay to local nonprofits who are helping those experiencing homelessness through our Rooms for Rooms program! The average weekend stay provides 16 nights in a bed, 100 free showers, or 30 free meals! None of this would be possible without our guests! Stay Here. Change Lives.

The space
This room has 1 king bed, custom made stained glass windows to let in light from the halls, and is 285 SF.

*Please note: This is an interior room so it has no exterior windows but it has plenty of lighting!*

Guest access
Access to the building and guest rooms is through a unique key code that we send via email the day before arrival. There is not a check-in desk or on-site concierge but we are always a phone call or text away if needed!

Other things to note
There is a parking lot across the street exclusive for guests of The Russell.  Each room booked is allotted one free parking space!

**Rates include housekeeping service upon departure only.
